description:
Create integration crates that let the existing Rust TLS ecosystem use PKIX as the certificate verifier. Without this, PKIX is a better engine that nobody can install in their car.

Deliverables:
1. pkix-rustls-provider: impl rustls::crypto::CryptoProvider or rustls::ServerCertVerifier backed by pkix-chain + DefaultVerifier. This is the highest-impact integration — rustls is the dominant Rust TLS library.
2. pkix-ring-verifier: impl SignatureVerifier backed by ring (for callers who want ring's asm-optimized crypto instead of RustCrypto).
3. Example: reqwest + pkix-rustls-provider working end-to-end.
4. Example: hyper + pkix-rustls-provider working end-to-end.

Approach: We may need to PR upstream to rustls to expose the right extension points, or work with the rustls ServerCertVerifier trait as-is. Research required.

May also want: pkix-wolfcrypt-verifier as the FIPS story (wolfSSL's own product).

Acceptance: A reqwest HTTPS client validates a real TLS connection using PKIX path validation + system trust store, with no rustls-webpki in the dep tree.
title: Rust TLS ecosystem integration: rustls, ring, reqwest
